newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ivorian foreign minister is candidate for OAU post.
newsitem.headline: Ivorian foreign minister is candidate for OAU post.

text.p: Ivorian Foreign Minister Amara Essy will challenge incumbent Salim Ahmed Salim for the post of secretary-general of the Organisation of African Unity, diplomats and OAU sources said on Thursday.
They said an official letter from the Ivorian government requesting that Essy, 52, be listed as one of the candidates had reached OAU headquarters in Addis Ababa.
Salim has declared his candidature for a third four-year term and faces another election in June at an OAU summit in Harare.
The only OAU head to hold office for three terms was Diallo Telli, a Guinean killed in still unexplained circumstances after he was called home and jailed by then Marxist ruler Ahmed Sekou Toure.
Diplomats said Essy, a lawyer, enjoyed the support of most West and North African states. He was his country's envoy to the United Nations between 1981-1990.
